title.zh: 尽量减少恶意软件的传播 II

desc.zh: 删除节点及其边，用健康连通组的唯一感染边界计算收益。
desc.en: Delete a node and its edges; count clean groups with a sole infected boundary source.

concepts.name: Clean components and sole-source ownership
concepts.description: Exclude original sources, then credit groups with one distinct infected boundary neighbor.
